name: Lost-wax casting
summary: A method that melts a wax model out of a mould and fills the empty space with molten metal.
how: Carve or form the model in wax.
Cover the model with clay and bake it, so that the wax melts out.
Pour molten metal into the empty mould and break the mould.

origin.note: Metalworkers cast small copper objects from a wax model.

adoptions.via: Studio jewellers cast silver and gold from their own wax models, in runs of a few pieces.
London jewellers cast gold from rough models, so that the surface looks like rock or bark.
